stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

Preserve connected shapes.\\n    for r in range(R):\\n        for c in range(C):\\n            if (r,c) in seen:\\n                continue\\n            color=grid[r][c]\\n            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]\\n            while q:\\n                y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))\\n                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):\\n                    if 0<=yy<R and 0<=xx<C and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:\\n                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))\\n            if len(comp)==1:\\n                y,x=comp[0]\\n                neighbors=[grid[yy][xx] for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1))\\n                           if 0<=yy<R and 0<=xx<C and grid[yy][xx]!=color]\\n                if neighbors:\\n                    g[y][x]=Counter(neighbors).most_common(1)[0][0]\\n    return g\\n')\"",
